title: Prove native Windows machine fixtures and the drift seal on a lab
text: Source tests cover the fixture library, the undo every native Windows reset runs before it restores, the machine-baseline drift checks, the Azure run-command runner and the host-command --fixture, --elevated and --second-user flags; the disposable Windows runner proves the scripts parse and that task-scheduler-restricted, grant-admin and applocker apply and undo idempotently. Still owed on the shipped release: plan 19862 rerun on a native lab with every machine-wide 5b cell recording pass or fail, passing undo records, a fresh-host reset passing machine-baseline, and proof that a planted applocker fixture left unreset fails the reset as probe_machine_drift and a plain reset clears it.
